name: Marazoleja (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a blue band of one quarter of the width from the upper hoist to the lower fly.
history: Marazoleja adopted its arms and flag officially on 30 August 2005, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 4 December 2007; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a yellow cloth with a blue diagonal stripe of 1/4 of the width from the upper hoist corner.

features.role: band of 1/4 of the width from the upper hoist to the lower fly
